locator.text: Display 51.4, p. 51, in the proof of Lemma 5.2

evidence: paper: U_0 = 0, \qquad E_0 = e_* f(\eta)\, R^{-1-2\lambda}, \qquad e_* > 0, \quad \lambda > 0,

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has a stronger form of it. Same two conditions on the patch (I_pos in the paper, the interval Ioo a b in Lean), with the same exponent -1-2λ and the same λ > 0. Two differences, both in Lean's favour. (i) The paper's product e_* f(η) is carried as a single η-dependent amplitude A(η); the split into a constant times a profile is never needed. (ii) Where the paper assumes e_* > 0 and f "smooth and bounded away from zero", the Lean hypotheses are ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ A S together with the pointwise A eta ≠ 0 — strictly less than positivity and than a uniform lower bound — so the Lean repair theorem covers the paper's case and more. The angular field E is E = (R/C)φ (GlobalSlowProfiles.angularField), matching the paper's φ_n = (C/R)E_n.
